t: You're looking at a wood carving called Peace, a tree sculpture standing near the Imperial War Museum. The name suits its neighbour. It was made by mORGANICo, an artist working in graffiti and wood carving who is known for local artworks around Lambeth. That local connection is the point here. This isn't a distant monument, it's a piece by someone whose work is part of the neighbourhood's street life. Take a moment to walk around it and look at how the carving follows the shape of the wood.
